ns2:course.label: Intermediate Wolof I
ns2:course.description: Survey of more advanced grammar, with emphasis on increasing conversational fluency, composition skills, study of written texts in standard and Dakar Wolof, and discussion of grammatical variations. Same as AFST 443. Summer 2008: 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Fall 2008: 4 hours only. Participation in language laboratory may be required. Prerequisite: WLOF 202.
